Indexed marks/focus survive reorder/filter within one dataset. A new indexed listing clears marks; the held-entry model separately preserves only qualified held successors on refresh. WP02 must implement and validate application-scale refresh/invalidation semantics. No existing cache ID is promoted to a live operation binding.

Collision inspection has exact lexical duplicates, native existing-object aliases and qualified Linux extended-filesystem distinct-name rules. Unqualified Windows/Darwin/casefold/encrypted policies remain unavailable, without invented Unicode algorithms or safe-to-create claims. WP03 must resolve or block operation-specific collision uncertainty.

Native qualification is limited to recorded hosts/features and private casefold ext4 coverage. It does not close the full WP07 filesystem/provider/fault matrix or WP08 application/terminal release gates.
